summary.name: Art Deco (supplemental design reference; not a directly named source style).
summary.visualIdentity: Explicit: axial symmetry, stepped silhouettes, sunbursts and repeated geometric ornament. Precise geometric display type. Forms draw toward the center and layers reveal. Controlled highlight sweeps, not indiscriminate gold effects.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: ornament-led titles and posters, premium editorial layouts, cinematic staging, hotel, theater or gala openers, invitations, menus, product launches and premium landing pages. Inferred from these notes; not exhaustive.
summary.limitations: Explicit: avoid pastel film grading, asymmetric handheld moves, repeated gold shimmer, blur or sparkle effects, ornament competing with copy, and beige editorial backgrounds. Two-color contrast checks do not prove readability over texture, video or animated light. Delivery aspect ratio, duration and resolution are unspecified.
summary.palette: Suggestion only, not approved. Background #151515 is illustrative; background is scene-dependent and not required, so choose it from subject and lighting. Foreground #F6EEDC. Accent #B99A57 for ornament and one highlight sweep. Gradients disabled. Jewel-tone palettes are also allowed. Contrast: foreground on background 15.811; accent on background 6.802. Task-supplied exact colors override these.
summary.motionAndInteraction: Explicit: reveal layers, draw forms toward the center, and use controlled highlight sweeps. Video runs on composition time. Interactive scroll progress is optional, with a static centered state under reduced motion. Optional references: motion-012 chapter handoff, motion-015 story steps, and motion-039 radial burst. Motion-039 lists Art Deco as a good fit but needs real mark assets and restrained, sparkle-free accents.
summary.audio: Unspecified: the source requires no music, voiceover or sound effects. Inferred: sparse, restrained sound suits this style and leaves room for copy. No genre, tempo or voice is fixed. Any sound or beat synchronization requires inspected audio; none is claimed otherwise.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads are required. The source supplies no fonts, marks, images or exact copy, so font choice is unspecified and display type must be selected and loaded locally. Motion-039 needs approved mark geometry or glyph assets; do not invent a brand mark or product copy. Its referenced review file was not inspected.
summary.combinations: style-104: axial camera staging with symmetric push-ins toward sunburst centers; gold limited to ornament and one sweep; no asymmetric moves. style-020: copy hierarchy with ornament framing content, never sitting behind body text; one display face and one text face. Art Deco alone suits titles and posters.
summary.productionApproach: SVG owns paths, ornaments, masks, clipping and stroke reveals. GSAP's paused, seekable timeline owns motion; Motion is optional and must be synchronized to it. HyperFrames is the default pipeline for assembly, timing, audio and export; Remotion only on a verified fallback condition. chroma-js is optional for contrast checks. Verify forward, backward and direct seeks.
